name: com.natcatcover/natcatcover
title: NatCat Cover
description: US natural catastrophe cover research: check an area, read the terms, register interest.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Search the NatCat Cover knowledge base (natural catastrophe insurance basics, the planned portfolio, structure, UK). Returns up to 5 pages with short answer, URL, markdown URL and last-updated date. Cite the URL and date.

query.description: A question or keywords in plain words

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List every knowledge-base topic (slug, title, summary, URL), optionally for one section.

section.description: Optional section, e.g. basics, portfolio, structure, value, uk, capital, status, about

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: Fetch the full markdown of one topic by slug (e.g. "structure/captive-layer"), including sources and last-updated date.

slug.description: Topic slug from list_topics or search_knowledge

tools.name: describe_portfolio
tools.description: Describe the planned peril portfolios (who each is for, status) and the protection layers. Research stage: nothing is on sale.

peril.description: Optional peril id or name, e.g. us-hurricane, flood

tools.name: check_area
tools.description: Count anonymous and confirmed registrations of interest for a peril in an area group (first 3 ZIP digits, or UK postcode area letters). Returns no personal data. Zones are not yet published.

area.description: US 5-digit ZIP, or UK postcode district only (e.g. SW1A)

tools.name: what_do_you_need
tools.description: Which property details matter for catastrophe cover and where to find them: relevant knowledge-base pages with short answers and URLs.

tools.name: register_interest
tools.description: Register the user’s interest in cover being offered in their area. Only call this with the user’s explicit agreement and set user_consented true. Peril and area are enough; email is optional (one confirmation email is then sent); set consent_contact true only if the user also wants to be emailed when cover opens in their zone. This is not an application for insurance and gives no quote.

area.description: US 5-digit ZIP, or UK postcode district only (e.g. SW1A), never a full postcode

consent_contact.description: User agrees to be emailed when cover opens in their zone

problem.description: Main problem with current cover, as on the register page

feedback.description: Free text, max 1000 chars; no sensitive details

user_consented.description: Must be true: the user has agreed to this registration
